question: What is the meaning of end-of-life information in relation to circular information?
description: End-of-life information refers to the documentation on sorting, collecting, and treating objects during their end-of-life phase. This information is crucial for assessing the environmental and social impact of a product throughout its life cycle, including its origin, design, production, usage, and disposal. In the context of circular information, end-of-life data helps businesses optimize the design, production, usage, and disposal of their products, ultimately contributing to a circular economy by enabling recycling and reducing waste.
